Kotak Mahindra Bank Q2 profit rises 29%

articles.headline: Kotak Mahindra Bank Reports Strong Q2 Growth
articles.brief: Kotak Mahindra Bank posted a 29% rise in Q2 net profit, beating analyst estimates, driven by strong net interest income and healthy lending growth across key segments.

articles.headline: Road Ministry Seeks Forensic Audit After Data Leak
articles.brief: The Ministry of Road Transport and Highways has requested a forensic audit of its digital portals following a major vehicle data leak, seeking intervention to strengthen cybersecurity policies.

articles.headline: Johnson & Johnson Prostate Drug Shrinks Tumors
articles.brief: An early-stage clinical trial shows that Johnson & Johnson's experimental prostate cancer drug successfully shrinks tumors, offering new hope for advanced cancer treatment therapies.

articles.headline: Iran Claims Strait Control After Tanker Explosions
articles.brief: Iran claimed control over the Strait of Hormuz after two oil supertankers reportedly struck naval mines, while Tehran warned US warships against entering the Persian Gulf.

articles.headline: Magnitude 7.2 Earthquake Strikes Near Vanuatu
articles.brief: A powerful magnitude 7.2 earthquake struck the waters near Vanuatu, triggering regional tsunami monitoring systems, though no immediate major damage reports have surfaced.

articles.headline: France Deploys 70,000 Police Amid Nationwide Unrest
articles.brief: French authorities deployed around 70,000 police officers as thousands took to the streets across major cities to protest living costs and education policies, leading to localized clashes.

articles.headline: Saudi Coalition Intercepts Houthi Ballistic Missiles
articles.brief: The Saudi-led coalition announced it successfully intercepted multiple Houthi ballistic missiles targeting major Saudi cities, amid an escalation in regional cross-border strikes.

articles.headline: India Secures Four-Wicket Victory Over New Zealand
articles.brief: A stellar batting performance led by Varma helped India secure a hard-fought four-wicket victory against New Zealand in a closely contested limited-overs international cricket match.

articles.headline: UK Urges Citizens to Store Three Days Supplies
articles.brief: The UK government launched the 'Be Ready' campaign advising citizens to store three days' worth of food, water, and cash at home to prepare for potential emergencies and cyber threats.

articles.headline: China Urges US to Halt Investment Curb Expansion
articles.brief: Beijing strongly urged Washington to halt its proposed expansion of outbound investment restrictions, warning that protectionist curbs threaten global economic stability and bilateral trade ties.
